Regarding the code's dependencies: The provided HTML snippet includes a link to the Bootstrap 4.3.1 CSS library hosted on StackPath CDN. The impact of this dependency is that the webpage's styling relies entirely on this external resource. If the CDN is unavailable, slow, or blocked, the page will load without any styling, resulting in a plain, unformatted appearance. Additionally, relying on an external CDN introduces a security and privacy consideration, as the browser must fetch resources from a third-party server.
